Title: Dungeons are open
Text: 16 dungeons are back, from the Bandit Hideout and the Bat Cave to Darvon's Descent and the Haunted Mines. Pick one from the Battles list in the Games window, or click the Frostfang Caverns cave mouth in Snowhill. Fight past the guards at their posts, beat the boss at the end and take the Exit for coins and stars.

Title: Presents to open
Text: Mystery gifts, grab bags, random clothes, tools and accessories, tournament winnings and bonus stars open now. A gift opens as soon as you get it, and any you already have get a Use button in your inventory. There are new emotes too: type !emote for the dances, poses and the rest.

Title: More challenges
Text: Townsfolk have 32 more challenges for you. Melt Lealin's runaway snowmen, feed Waterwings' ducks, pass Lugabow's Test of Agility, flex for Garrison Gold's friends, put out Antonio's burning kart, sign autographs for Roxy's fans and hand out tickets for Therin. Medics, Postmen, Kart and Demo Derby Drivers and Soccer Stars all have new ones to try.

Title: Achievements
Text: The Achievements window is open: 321 achievements from jobs, battles, quests, minigames, housing, pets and rides, with trophies, points and titles to earn. What you've already done counts, so your job ranks and rides are there the first time you look.

Title: Recipes and crafting
Text: Hold a recipe card to learn its recipe, then make it at a cooking table or an anvil (anvils smelt bars too). Make It plays the recipe's game, and a win turns your ingredients into the dish, bar or weapon. Cooking tables, game tables, harvest fields, mining veins and postboxes across the world all work now.

Title: The Housing Directory
Text: Proud of your house? Submit it to the Housing Directory from its side panel. Visit the most popular, the newest and your friends' houses, search by name, and vote one to five stars on the houses you visit.

Title: Shops all over
Text: Every job's gear vendor has stock now, and so do the stylists, pet suppliers, potion sellers, Dress Up! and the ride dealers Dusti Rodez and Charlie.

Title: Map pings for groups
Text: Click the minimap to ping a spot for your whole group, and see at a glance who in your group is choosing a job or playing a game.

Title: Three new homes
Text: Move up to Skyhaven Isle, a meadow floating high above the clouds; down to Pearlshade Reef, a sunlit lagoon on the sea floor; or into Blossomfall Terrace, a cherry-blossom garden at golden hour. Their deeds are in the Shop with the lots, and so is a set of matching furniture for each.

Title: Frostfang Growler!
Text: The Frostfang Growlers prowling Snowhill want a fight. Click one to start a battle, and bring your group: five waves of wolves in a forest clearing, then the Frostfang Alpha. Clear them all and take the Exit for coins and stars. Get knocked out five times and the wolves win.

Title: Take a challenge
Text: Townsfolk all over Fabled Realms have challenges for you: race Finn and Sundancer through the flags, find Flitter's scattered mail, round up Lazi's pigs and Farmer Murglot's chicks, bring Rainchaser her starfish, or pass a Ninja test. Click them to see what they need. Beat the clock for coins and stars.

Title: Gone fishing
Text: Click the dock at Rainbow Lake, Sacred Grove Shallows, Darklit Lagoon, Brambleback's Bayou, Wintery Basin or Frostbitten Banks, or pick a pond under Games > Fishing, to fish there as a Fisherman. Cast onto a school, wait for the bite and reel in: 40 fish in up to four sizes, legendary ones among them, plus coin pouches, treasure chests and the odd old boot. Lures help you catch a particular fish, and the pond's fisherman sells them, along with better rods.

Title: Fresh fits from Cragara
Text: The Mysterious Merchant has new streetwear for humans and pixies alike: bomber, racer, puffer and track jackets, a flannel shirt, an OSFR graphic tee, track pants, cargo pants and shorts, distressed jeans, a tennis skirt, high-tops, combat boots, flip-flops, a beanie, a bucket hat and a baseball cap, all dyeable. She also has four new hairstyles: a mohawk fade, a curly top fade, an afro puff and half-up space buns.

Title: Show off your moves
Text: Type !emote and a dance to bust a move everyone nearby can see: twerk, griddy, dab, floss, robot, runningman, moonwalk, disco, sprinkler, carlton, macarena, shuffle or headbang. Looping dances keep going until you walk away or type !emote stop.

Title: The Shop has it all
Text: Job gear for every rank, jewelry, tools, food, potions, crafting and farming supplies, pets, karts, houses and more are in the Shop now, and every price is on one list: the higher the rank, the more it costs.

Title: Lavender Coast joins the map
Text: Walk south from Sacred Grove through Lavender Coast Pass, or down the Wildwood valley, to a coast of lava rock round a smoking volcano: Lavender Landing's warpstone, the Lilac Terraces, the black sand of Basalt Shore, the lava rivers of Emberwood and, up in the crater, Cinder Crown.

Title: Minigames are open!
Text: Open the Games window from the Main Menu to mine ore, forge gear, cook, smelt, sort the mail, defend your farm, keep the beat, or play chess and checkers. Win to earn coins, stars for your job and whatever you made.

Title: The Mysterious Merchant is back
Text: Cragara turns up in a different town every hour, selling things you won't find in the Shop: the OSFR Foam Costume, streetwear, new hairstyles and more. Watch chat to find out where she is, and be quick: she never stays long!

Title: Join live events
Text: When a Referee hosts an event, everyone online gets the call. Type !join to go straight there from anywhere, and stick around for prizes!

Title: Rank up your jobs
Text: Defeating enemies, finishing quests and completing collections now earn stars for the job you're in. Fill the bar to rank up, all the way to rank 20: every rank gives more health and harder hits.

Title: Team up and trade
Text: Click another player to Invite to Group (up to five) or to Trade items and coins. Group members fighting together share stars, coins and loot.

Title: Loot to find
Text: Enemies drop potions, orbs and coins, and the tough ones always leave something behind. Open a Thick Pocket Book or a Robgoblin Treasure Trove to see what's inside!

Title: Quests are here!
Text: Talk to the folks with a marker over their heads to pick up quests. Track your goals in the Hero's Journal and earn rewards when you're done.

Title: Move into your own house
Text: Houses are open! Pick one out, then decorate it with furniture and make it yours.

Title: Everything costs coins
Text: Station Cash and memberships are gone. Everything in the Shop is bought with the coins you earn playing.

Title: Spin the daily wheel
Text: Find the daily wheel in the Games window and give it a spin for a prize.

Title: Potions, scrolls and treats
Text: Potions, scrolls, buff foods and illusion masks work now. Try them out and see what happens!

Title: Pets and collections
Text: Bring a pet along on your adventures, and look for sparkles in the world to fill out your collections.

Title: Got a code?
Text: Press Enter and type !redeem to open the code box, then enter your code to claim items and coins.

Title: A fresh new look
Text: A new loading screen and this new home screen, with Referee Picks and your friends who are online.
